{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dac Extremists''' were a political radical group that existed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] and consisted of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] who opposed the dominance of their [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] cousins as well as the influence of outworlders. To the members of this organization, it was aim to make a Quarren-only homeworld.
